# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** 13  <sub>[v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, rosy cheeks, and jet-black hair. Her merry expression is inherited from her father.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c17 P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)_

## Personality

Diana is smart, well-mannered, and good-natured. She is a loyal and comfortable friend who laughs easily before speaking. She loves reading books, though her imagination is more grounded compared to Anne's, having been somewhat stifled after a scolding from her strict mother.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006)_

## History

Diana grew up at Orchard Slope in Avonlea. When Anne Shirley arrived at Green Gables, the two met and instantly pledged eternal bosom friendship. They shared adventures, built playhouses like Idlewild, named surrounding local landmarks, and formed a story club. Diana's mother temporarily banned her from interacting with Anne after an accidental drunkenness incident involving currant wine, but she was allowed to resume their friendship after Anne helped save Diana's little sister Minnie May during a severe case of croup. As they grew older, Diana participated in school concerts and events. Although she did not join the Queen's class to pursue higher studies because her parents did not intend to send her to Queen's Academy, she remained Anne's closest and most devoted friend.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021)_
